<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex66042024-09-1615-06-08" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> <milestone unit="section" n="Closing verses (81a3–81a4)"/>
            <lg><l>rnyed dka'i ° sky(es) dal 'byor mi lus kyi ||</l> <note type="editorial">The reading of skyes is tentative</note>
            <l>snying po len pa'i thabs kyi mchog gyur pa ||</l>
            <l>byang chub sems gnyis spyod tshul lung rigs la ||</l>
            <l>brten nas <lb n="81a4"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4221">kyi ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs</rs> kyis bshad ||</l>
            <l>dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun sems bskyed de ||</l>
            <l>byang chub spyod pa'i tshul la legs zhugs pas ||</l>
            <l>tshogs gnyis rgyu chen rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas ||</l> 
            <l>sku gsum nor bu'i dpal la spyod par shog ||</l></lg></seg></TEI>
